data.name: Sharushmita
data.gender_notes: Sharushmita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharu means 'abundance' and Smrita means 'memory'. This name signifies the goddess of wisdom and prosperity, who is believed to bestow wealth, happiness and success in life. It is also a name of Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music and arts. The name Sharushmita carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharushmita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek wisdom and prosperity in their life. It is believed that the goddess Sharushmita blesses her devotees with abundance, knowledge, creativity and success.
data.etymology: Sharushmita belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharushmita total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharushmita holds a deep rooted cultural significance in Hinduism. This is because Sharu (abundance) synonymous with prosperity and wealth, a concept deeply embedded in Hindu beliefs. Furthermore, Smrita (memory) signifies wisdom and knowledge. Hindu beliefs place immense importance on education, wisdom and knowledge, and the name Sharushmita represents these values. It symbolizes the goddess Saraswati, who is the patron goddess of arts, wisdom and learning. The name Sharushmita is often used as a respectful address for this deity, and is commonly found in Sanskrit literature and ancient Hindu texts.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Sharushmita revolves around the Hindu Goddess Saraswati. This goddess is the embodiment of wisdom, knowledge, music, arts, culture, education and learning. In Hindusim, it is believed that wisdom and knowledge are the highest forms of spiritual attainment, and that they are gateways to self-realization and enlightenment. The name Sharushmita, meaning 'goddess of abundance and memory', reflects the belief that wisdom and knowledge are abundant and easily accessible to those who seek them with an open mind and heart. Thus, this name represents the spiritual journey towards self-realization, and the importance of accumulating wisdom and knowledge along the way.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sharushmita is a name that embodies the divine goddess Saraswati, symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, and creativity. It is believed that those named Sharushmita are blessed with these divine qualities, inspiring them to seek truth and enlightenment.
